# New renderings — iliad-082 (13.455–559)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| βριήπυος ὄβριμος Ἄρης (13.521) | "loud-voiced, mighty Ares" | "Ares, loud-voiced and mighty" (+ note: formation uncertain, probably βρι- "strong" + ἠπύω "call out") | "loud-shouting", "loud-roaring", "of the strong voice", "clamorous"; ὄβριμος keeps "mighty" (table 3.357, 13.444) |
| θάνατος θυμοραϊστής (13.544) | "death … life-destroying" | "death, the destroyer of life" | "heart-shattering", "soul-breaking", "deadly" (loses θυμός); θυμός of the life that leaves a man is "life" (table 5.155) |
| ἀμύνω with the dative of a person and no thing warded off (γαμβρῷ ἀμυνέμεναι, 13.464 · καί μ’ οἴῳ ἀμύνετε, 13.481) | "defend" | "defend" | "ward off for" (the table keeps "ward off" for ἀμύνω with a thing warded off, 1.341, 13.424), "help" (ἀρήγω), "protect"; `ἐπαμύνω` stays "come to the defence of" (table 5.685, 6.361) |
| γαμβρός (13.464 γαμβρῷ, 13.466 γαμβρὸς ἐών; Alcathous, sister’s husband of Aeneas) | "brother-in-law" | "brother-in-law" | "son-in-law" (his relation to Anchises at 13.428, where he is Anchises’ γαμβρός; the table’s γαμβρός "son-in-law" is a daughter’s husband), "kinsman by marriage"; follows the table’s γαμβροῖσι (5.474) for a sister’s husband |
| ἐπιμηνίω (Πριάμῳ ἐπεμήνιε, 13.460) | "was wrathful against" | "was wrathful against" | "had a grudge against", "was angry with" (anger is χόλος); keeps the table’s ἐμήνιε "was wrathful" (1.247) |
| ὕστατον ὁμίλου (13.459) | "last of the throng" | "at the very rear of the throng" | "last in the crowd", "farthest back"; ὅμιλος "throng" (table 3.340, 4.209) |
| βοηθόος (Αἰνείαν ἐπιόντα βοηθόον, 13.477) | "the helper" | "who came on to help" | "rescuer", "swift to the cry" (the etymology goes in the note), "supporter" |
| ἀλέξασθαι (13.475, aorist infinitive middle with accusative) | "defend itself against" | "defend itself against" | "ward off" (kept for ἀμύνω), "fend off", "resist" |
| γάνυται (13.493, of the shepherd) | "delighted" | "is delighted" | "rejoices" (kept for γηθέω), "glad" (γέγηθε, table 8.559), "brightens" |
| ἔθνος λαῶν (13.495) | "the company of the people" | "the company of the troops" | "tribe", "nation", "host", "army" (λαοί plural is "troops", table 2.577–580); follows the table’s ἔθνος ἑταίρων "company", 11.585 |
| βόμβησε (of a helmet falling, 13.530) | "boomed" | "boomed" | "clanged" (kept for ἔβραχε, 4.420), "rang" (κονάβιζε, 2.466), "clattered", "hummed" |
| πήληξ (13.527) · κόρυς (13.543) | "helmet" · "helmet" | "helmet" · "helmet" | "helm" (kept for `l` of τρυφάλεια), "casque", "headpiece"; the three Greek words for the one object are told apart in the notes |
| ἑάφθη (ἐπὶ δ’ ἀσπὶς ἑάφθη καὶ κόρυς, 13.543; rare aorist passive of ἅπτω) | "fell" (upon him) | "fell upon him" (+ note: sense not certain) | "was fastened on", "was laid on", "was dragged down" (each decides the unknown) |
| περισταδόν · ἄλλοθεν ἄλλος (13.551) | "standing round" · "from here, from there" | "standing all round" · "one from one side and another from another" | "from every side", "in a ring", "in a circle" |
| ἐπιγράψαι (13.553, of a spear and skin) | "graze" | "graze" | "scratch" (kept in the note), "pierce", "cut" (ταμέειν at 13.501), "wound" (οὐτάω) |
| οὐτάζω (οὔταζον, 13.552) | "kept thrusting at" | "kept stabbing at" | "wounded" (kept for οὐτάω, 13.546 "wounded"), "struck" (βάλλω, τύπτω) |
| στρωφάω (στρωφᾶτο, 13.557) | "kept turning about" | "kept turning about" | "wheeled", "circled", "moved about" |
| ἀτρέμας ἔχε (13.557, of a spear) | "stay motionless" | "stayed motionless" | "stay still", "stand still", "hold steady"; ἀτρέμας "motionless" (table 5.523, 13.280, 13.438) |
| ἐλέλικτο (13.558, of a spear) | "was whirled" | "was … whirled" | "twisted", "coiled" (the snake, 11.39), "was brandished" |
| ἀκοντίζω + genitive of the target (13.502, 13.516, 13.559) | "cast at" | "cast at" | "hurled at", "threw at"; follows the published 13.402 (iliad-081, "cast with his shining spear") |
| αὖε δ’ ἑταίρους (13.477) | "called to" | "called out to" | "shouted to", "hailed"; follows the published 11.461 (iliad-068) |
| μῆλα (13.491) | "flocks" | "flocks" | "sheep" (kept for ὄις); table row, no departure |
| δόμοις ἔνι (13.465) | "in his house" | "in his house" | "halls" (kept for μέγαρα); table row (5.198, 11.223), no departure |

Departures from shared English: none; the lines of this part that stand in a published part (13.462, 13.468–469, 13.479–480, 13.488, 13.503, 13.508/520 ἕλε γαῖαν ἀγοστῷ, 13.540, 13.549, 13.458) take the published wording, with the names changed where the speaker or the stirred man differs (13.468 "Aeneas’ breast", 13.503 "Idomeneus"), and the Odyssey line 13.458 is the Odyssey’s `i` ("And this, as he thought it over, seemed to him the better course") with a colon.

One-off rare words (αὐλῶπις, κολοσυρτός, οἰοπόλος, κτίλος, τηλύγετος, ἀγοστός, νεούτατος, δυσηχής, ἐελμένος, ἐεργόμενοι) are rendered in the units from the table or from their roots and discussed in the notes only.
